candidate.license: Apache-2.0 upstream YOLOX release/repository; included upstream license and source provenance under evaluation/yolox-reference
candidate.input: 1x3x416x416 float32 BGR,0..255,no normalization; preserve aspect ratio using top-left anchored resized image and bottom/right114padding
candidate.output: 1x3549x85, grid/stride decode8,16,32; exp widths/heights,objectness*class scores,class-agnostic NMS.45,reference inclusive pixel-area+1 convention
candidate.role: Isolated additional candidate experiment; not an Android production asset unless independent selection/calibration/new80-photo audit justify integration

prior_test_use: Old80test is excluded from this additional candidate selection and final claims; it motivated investigating another model only

selection_rule.fast_replacement: selection AP50>=FAST+.04 AND AP50:95>=FAST+.04 AND paired full-task P50<=FAST*1.30
selection_rule.inspect_replacement: selection AP50>=INSPECT-.03 AND AP50:95>=INSPECT-.03 AND paired full-task P50<=INSPECT*.70
selection_rule.precision_threshold_choice: Selection uses ranked AP, not confidence probability comparisons. Threshold selection occurs only on calibration; calibration must preserve reference precision and bounded FP/image, and improve recall by.02 before freshaudit

paired_timing.model_order: rotate all3model orders across shuffled identical image/repeat trials
